verdict.rationale: The evidence never documents a way for an Amplitude user to opt out of Amplitude's own telemetry or usage tracking, for example from the Wizard CLI, MCP server or dashboard. The SDK consent model and session-replay consent controls govern data a customer collects from its own end users. That is an adjacent feature, not an opt-out of the product tracking its user.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
